mapper.insert:
insert into employee_schedule (id, clinic_id, employee_id, schedule_id, work_date, crt_id, crt_name, crt_time, upd_id, upd_name, upd_time, inservice) VALUES
(#{item.id,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{item.clinicId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{item.employeeId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{item.scheduleId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{item.workDate,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{item.crtId,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{item.crtName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{item.crtTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{item.updId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{item.updName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{item.updTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{item.inservice,jdbcType=BIT})
mapper.select: select bs.name, bs.type, bs.first_start_time as firstStartTime, bs.first_end_time as firstEndTime, bs.second_start_time as secondStartTime, bs.second_end_time as secondEndTime, bs.inservice from base_schedule bs left join employee_schedule es on bs.id=es.schedule_id where es.id = #{id}

select sum(num) from ( select count(*) num from leave_schedule ls left join leave_info li on li.id = ls.leave_id where li.approval_status in (0,1) and ls.schedule_id = #{id} and li.user_id = #{employeeId} UNION select count(*) num from leave_info where approval_status in (0,1) and DATE_FORMAT(end_time,'%Y-%m-%d') >= DATE_FORMAT(#{workDate},'%Y-%m-%d') and DATE_FORMAT(start_time,'%Y-%m-%d') <= DATE_FORMAT(#{workDate},'%Y-%m-%d') and user_id = #{employeeId} UNION select count(*) num from work_overtime_info wi LEFT JOIN employee_schedule es on es.id = wi.rest_schedule_id where wi.approval_status in (0,1) and DATE_FORMAT(wi.work_date,'%Y-%m-%d') = DATE_FORMAT(#{workDate},'%Y-%m-%d') AND (es.schedule_id = #{scheduleId} or wi.schedule_id = #{scheduleId}) and wi.user_id = #{employeeId} UNION select count(*) num from field_info where approval_status in (0,1) and DATE_FORMAT(end_time,'%Y-%m-%d') >= DATE_FORMAT(#{workDate},'%Y-%m-%d') and DATE_FORMAT(start_time,'%Y-%m-%d') <= DATE_FORMAT(#{workDate},'%Y-%m-%d') and user_id = #{employeeId} ) a

select es.id as employeeScheduleId,es.clinic_id as orgId,es.schedule_id as scheduleId,es.employee_id as userId,es.work_date as scheduleDate, bs.first_start_time as startWorkTime,IFNULL(bs.second_end_time,bs.first_end_time) as offWorkTime, TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE,(DATE_FORMAT(bs.first_start_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')),(DATE_FORMAT(IFNULL(bs.second_end_time,bs.first_end_time),'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s'))) as scheduleDuration from employee_schedule es LEFT JOIN base_schedule bs on es.schedule_id = bs.id where es.id = #{id}
